summary: designer-stats and designer-compare must take free/POD/sale/type counts from Algolia facets (catalog-wide) when the index returns them; price and newest remain hit-derived and must set sampled=true when scanned < total_products.
reason: A designer's catalog can exceed Algolia's 1000-hit window. Facets give accurate catalog-wide counts without walking every product; presenting a bounded newest sample as those counts understates large designers. Remaining hit-derived stats must not be implied to be complete.
